newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jialing Group in joint motorcycle venture.
newsitem.headline: China Jialing Group in joint motorcycle venture.

text.p: China's biggest motorcycle maker, China Jialing Group, parent of China Jialing Industrial Co Ltd, has set up Zhejiang Jialing Jili Motorcycle Co Ltd with the Zhejiang-based China Jili Group, officials said on Monday.
They refused to give further details.

The Economic Daily gave no details on the size of the stake held by Jialing, based in southwestern Sichuan province, but said the firm wanted a partner for about 10 years to further develop its business.
China Jili Group is the fifth largest of China's top 1,000 township enterprises, the newspaper said.
